sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and "id" = $1 and "id" >= $2 and "id" <= $3 and "cliente_potencial_recurrente" = $4

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and "id" = $1 and "id" >= $2 and "id" <= $3 and "cliente_potencial_recurrente" = $4 order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $5 offset $6
